name: dogfood-supabase-realtime-chat
description: Dogfood app 1 (v1.13-3) — a Supabase Realtime chat + presence + typing indicator app that exercises broadcast, presence tracking, and typing debounce across a provider-neutral interface, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls @supabase/supabase-js when SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-test/realtime createSupabaseRealtimeMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/realtime -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
